description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterObject class, which provides a method to unregister objects from a Smarty template object, indicating that it is a part of the Smarty template engine's internal plugin system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterObject
classes.description: Provides an internal method to unregister objects from Smarty templates.

methods.name: unregisterObject
methods.description: Unregisters a specified object from the Smarty template's registered objects.
